listing.name: The Abyss Stares Back [1.1]
listing.summary: Gives the shrouded eye a laser pointer that instills fear in any ship it touches, causing them to back away. This may make shrouded fights easier, depending on whether or not you are running ships that could otherwise just facetank the eye. Comes in two flavors, one with a visible targeting laser (I SEE YOU), one without
listing.aiSummary: Adds a fear-inducing laser pointer to the shrouded eye anomaly.

description: Instills fear in ships touched by the shrouded eye, causing them to back away. This can make fights against the anomaly easier, especially against ships that would otherwise facetank it. Two versions are available: one with a visible targeting laser and one without.
descriptionHtml: Instills fear in ships touched by the shrouded eye, causing them to back away. This can make fights against the anomaly easier, especially against ships that would otherwise facetank it. Two versions are available: one with a visible targeting laser and one without.
discordPostHtml:
Gives the shrouded eye a laser pointer that instills fear in any ship it touches, causing them to back away. This may make shrouded fights easier, depending on whether or not you are running ships that could otherwise just facetank the eye.
Comes in two flavors, one with a visible targeting laser (I SEE YOU), one without

NOT safe to remove mid save, but you can nullify the mod by going into data/hulls and removing the entry for shrouded_eye.ship. Then the mod will have no effect on your existing save.
